acceptanceCriteria: The external map read and externalReportOutput open through a directory handle (os.Root or openat chain) so a swapped parent cannot redirect the read/write; a test swaps a parent directory between check and open and gets a typed refusal.
body: Codex finding (High) on PR beamfall/corvint#1337 (V1-2097): the containment check for the out-of-repository map path and externalReportOutput is pathname-based (publish.OpenRoot keeps a pathname), so a parent-directory swap between check and ReadBounded escapes containment (TOCTOU).
